group_results.reason: cJSON_Delete now sets valuestring and string to NULL after deallocating them. Its behavior is otherwise the same. The harness calls cJSON_Delete on every successfully parsed tree.

On its failure path, parse_string now sets the local output to NULL after freeing it. The function still returns false. The harness reaches this path through cJSON_ParseWithOpts with malformed strings.
After reallocate succeeds, print() sets buffer->buffer to NULL. It still returns printed, and the harness frees that result with free().
On its failure path, print() sets local pointers to NULL after freeing them. It still returns NULL, and the harness handles a NULL printed_json.
When printing fails, cJSON_PrintBuffered now sets p.buffer to NULL after freeing it. It still returns NULL. The harness calls this function with prebuffer 1 and checks for NULL.
The only change to cJSON_free is assigning NULL to its by-value parameter, which has no effect outside the function. The harness never calls cJSON_free and frees printed output with free().

build.reason: build.sh only delegates to $SRC/cjson/fuzzing/ossfuzz.sh, which was not supplied. fuzzing/CMakeLists.txt builds cjson_read_fuzzer.c only into fuzz_main. The actual OSS-Fuzz compile and link recipe is therefore unread.

input.reason: The harness requires 4 flag bytes and a NUL as the last byte. This makes strlen in cJSON_ParseWithOpts bounded, and the parse API is unchanged.

lifecycle.reason: Printed output is freed once, the minify copy is freed once, and the parsed tree is deleted once. The changes only add NULL assignments to internal or local pointers after free.

control_flow.reason: The flag bytes select parse, the buffered/formatted/unformatted print branches and minify. The declarations of every public API used match the harness calls.

missing_information: Contents of fuzzing/ossfuzz.sh, the delegated OSS-Fuzz build recipe, which is needed to confirm the build foundation

assumptions: The default global_hooks use malloc and free, so calling free() on printed output is valid. This is unchanged by the diff.
